subject: Shuffling in new questions to mirtCAT session

messages.author: e3a6f56cec6d93f6
messages.subject: Shuffling in new questions to mirtCAT session
parts:
I am trying to gather data on items that are not included in `mirtCAT$mo` model. I'd like to shuffle these in randomly into the `mirtCAT` session. It seems that the `constraints$not_scored` is restricted to items only in the `mirtCAT$mo` argument.

What's the best way to shuffle new items into the `mirtCAT` session? Is there a way to include items as not_scored in the mirt model so I can then mark them to be not scored?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Shuffling in new questions to mirtCAT session
parts:
Thanks for posting on the forum, Elliott. This is indeed a tricky question, because there are many variables that should be considered, such as whether the CAT session should still be adaptive, when to terminate the test in light of new (unscored) items, when/how many new items each person should receive, etc. 

To demonstrate the core concepts of this problem, I generated a new vignette on the wiki, located here: http://philchalmers.github.io/mirtCAT/html/unidim-newitems.html
This shows how to add two new unscored items to an existing bank, while ensuring that the items in the calibrated bank are still selected using the maximum-information criteria. I hope it helps highlight what needs to be done, and why setting up this data collection scheme can be a bit awkward (at first; after you see the result it isn't that bad or counter-intuitive). Cheers.

Phil
